## Walkthrough

RBAC rules for the kueue-priority-booster were updated to include the events.k8s.io API group: the controller's kubebuilder annotation and ClusterRole manifests now declare `events.k8s.io` for the `events` resource; one verbs list ordering was adjusted.

## Changes

**RBAC events.k8s.io permissions**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Controller RBAC events.k8s.io annotation** <br> `cmd/experimental/kueue-priority-booster/pkg/controller/controller.go`|Kubebuilder RBAC annotation corrected to specify `groups=events.k8s.io` for `resources=events` with `verbs=create;patch`.|
|**ClusterRole RBAC rule update (config)** <br> `cmd/experimental/kueue-priority-booster/config/rbac/role.yaml`|`ClusterRole` updated to include `apiGroups: ["events.k8s.io"]` for `resources: [events]`; `verbs` entries reordered (`patch` before `watch`).|
|**Helm chart ClusterRole template update** <br> `cmd/experimental/kueue-priority-booster/charts/kueue-priority-booster/templates/manager.yaml`|Chart `manager.yaml` ClusterRole rule extended to include `events.k8s.io` in `apiGroups` alongside the core group for `events` `create`/`patch` permissions.|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes
